notes.title: 4.02 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello Fighters,

Thanks for your support! We have urgently dealt with some problems that affect the experience. At present, there are still many points that are being optimized and adjusted. It is not easy for small teams like us to keep on developing. Thank you for your understanding ~

-Build: 4.02

-Date: 2020/5/8

Here are the patch updates for the week.


[b]【Changed】[/b]

1.Added auxiliary line between jumping point and landing point to help fighters improve the accuracy of the jumping.

2.Added list of cheating fighters. We will restrict the functions of cheating players according to the list and cancel their rankings

3.Optimized the auxiliary aiming detection function for keyboard, we hope to bring more convenience to fighters.

4.Optimized the auxiliary aiming detection function for handle, we hope to bring more convenience to fighters.

5.Adjusted the difficulty and clearance conditions of each level in story mode.

6.The battle preparation room in the battle mode now open all robots by default, and the homeowner can delete it by himself.

[b]【Fixed】[/b]

1.Fixed the problem that Vacuumatic suction residue.

2.Fixed the problem that sudden abnormal shaking of weapons during the battle.

3.Fixed the problem that the model is displayed abnormally due to different status props.

4.Fixed the problem that special attack effect of falling when fighters are defeated by guns.

5.Fixed the problem that weapon destroyed for no reason and fighters have to holding the weapon gesture when they pick up a weapon.

6.Fixed the problem that scrolling subtitle display error.

7.Fixed the problem that interface stuck with award ceremony due to network problem.

8.Fixed the problem that no clearance record in the 12th level of story mode.

9.Fixed the problem that Sniper has a certain chance to be brought to the award ceremony stage.

10.Fixed the problem that there is a certain chance that the stages could not be chosen in the Challenge Stage.

[b]【Weapon Adjusted】
[/b]
1.Sniper-Reduce single shot damage in Battle mode.

2.Bazooka-Reduce single shot damage in Battle mode.

3.Ray Gun-Reduce damage per second in Battle mode.

4.Thunderclap-Reduce damage per second in Battle mode.

5.Shotgun-Reduce single shot damage in Battle mode.

6.Gatling-Reduce single shot damage in Battle mode.

7.Pistol-Reduce single shot damage in Battle mode.
